proxy_note: DEATHFANG (owner 2026-10-19): proprietary character based on Iori Yagami — keeps Iori's moves, stance and animations. Reskin: prisoner/slave to his own grief and emotions, chained/shackled, emo, with the Soul Eater 'NO FUTURE' face tattoo. Transforms into a chained prisoner werewolf (attire 2 / transform form; Free the werewolf of Soul Eater folds into that canon, as he did for Iori's own inspirations). Iori (KOF) has no T3 bank — Heihachi proxy (power), same bank as iori.json.
